text: {"assertions":["On 2026-01-07, a latency spike was identified in ml/serving/batcher.py where the serving histogram tail was significantly above the median.","The root cause of the latency spike was a naive datetime being compared against a timezone-aware datetime in the batcher.","The fix for the latency spike involved making every boundary timezone-aware at the edge, implemented in PR #1062 on branch fix/latency-spike-1.","After fixing the timezone awareness issue, throughput increased by 61%, reaching 440 requests per second.","The latency issue in the batcher only appeared after the client had already retried once.","The latency spike could be reproduced by sending a mixed-size request trace.","The batcher latency issue is covered by tests in tests/ml/test_batcher.py."]}
